map.网上学习 3 日累计满 30 分钟且合格减 1 分；现场学习满 1 小时减 2: 30 minutes of online study accumulated over 3 days with a pass reduces 1 point; 1 hour of classroom study reduces 2 points; 1 hour of public-service activity reduces 1 point; capped at 6 points per cycle
map.一般通行违法警告或 20~200 元；超速 50% 以上等 200~2000 元: Ordinary traffic violations draw a warning or 20~200 yuan; speeding over 50% and similar draw 200~2000 yuan; drink-driving draws 1000~2000 yuan plus a 6-month suspension
map.《道交法》第 90、91、99 条: Road Traffic Safety Law, Articles 90, 91 and 99
map.现场处罚决定书应自收到之日起 15 日内缴纳罚款；逾期不履行处罚决定的，每日按罚: Pay the fine on an on-site notice within 15 days of receipt; failing to comply adds 3% of the fine per day, with the total added no more than the fine itself. Electronic monitoring records must be accepted and the notice collected before paying on time; no late fee accrues before processing, though licence transactions are locked.
map.《道路交通安全违法行为记分管理办法》第三十五条明确：省、自治区、直辖市公安厅、局: Article 35 of the Measures for the Administration of Point Records for Road Traffic Violations states that provincial public security departments may set concrete enforcement standards within the range prescribed here. The same violation can therefore carry different fines in different regions; this page lists the statutory range, while the actual amount follows the penalty notice and the local traffic police publication.
map.⚠️ 本工具为记分与幅度的通用速查，不构成法律意见。对处罚有异议时，可在法定期限: ⚠️ This tool is a general quick reference to points and ranges, not legal advice. To contest a penalty, apply for administrative reconsideration or file an administrative lawsuit within the statutory deadline.

map.公安部令第 163 号（2022 年 4 月 1 日施行）规定一次记分分值为 1: Ministry of Public Security Decree No. 163 (in force from 2022-04-01) sets single-offence point values of 12, 9, 6, 3 and 1. Ignoring a traffic signal (running a red light) carries 6 points, speeding 20%~50% on expressways / fast roads carries 6 points, and drink-driving or speeding over 50% on expressways / fast roads carries 12 points. Note that ordinary small cars speeding under 20% are not pointed (only school buses and medium or larger passenger/cargo and dangerous-goods vehicles get 1 point for 10%~20% speeding off expressways). A points cycle runs 12 months to a 12-point maximum counted from the date the licence was first issued, so two 6-point offences in one cycle hit the maximum: the licence is detained and you attend 7 days of full-points study (30 days for large vehicles), with points cleared only after passing the exam and paying all fines. Eligible drivers may also cut up to 6 points per cycle through traffic-law study.
map.记分会跨年清零吗？: Do points reset at the turn of the year?
map.记分按记分周期（初次领证日起 12 个月）计算，不是自然年。周期结束前未达 12: Points run in a 12-month cycle starting from the date the licence was first issued, not the calendar year. If you stay below 12 points with fines paid by the end of the cycle, points clear; hitting 12 points means mandatory study.
map.滞纳金怎么算？: How is the late fee calculated?
map.逾期不履行处罚决定才产生滞纳金，一般每日按罚款数额 3% 且不超过本金。现场单: Late fees arise only once you fail to comply with the decision, generally 3% of the fine per day and capped at the original amount. Pay an on-site ticket within 15 days or handle a camera notice within the stated period and you avoid it.
map.记分依据公安部令第 163 号（2022-04-01 施行），罚款为道交法法定幅: Points follow Ministry of Public Security Decree No. 163 (in force from 2022-04-01); fines use the statutory ranges of the Road Traffic Safety Law, with actual amounts set by the penalty notice and local police publication
